messages:
olivia (partnerships): Heads-up — CloudCatalog listing is moving to final compliance gate. Need SOC reports, latest pen test summary, and the partner questionnaire answers for the SI announcement next week. Who can own collecting and redacting artifacts?
jamal (security): I can own the SOC/pen artifacts. Need to know retention/TTL for presigned links.
maya (legal): Confirm we're OK sharing SOC1 vs SOC2 summary. We'll only share SOC2 Type II cover pages and redacted control narratives. Full reports need an NDA.
olivia (partnerships): Good call. For the announcement we only need the one-page attestation + presigned link to evidence for marketplace review. NDA flow is set up with Rachel's team.
rachel (si-partner): I can coordinate the partner side. We have a SOC2 summary and a recent external pentest report. Need instructions on redaction fields and where to upload.
sam (infra): Upload to s3://redwood-catalog-evidence/cloudcatalog/si-acme/ -- put objects under yyyy-mm-dd/. We'll presign for 14 days by default. If you need shorter TTL say it.
jamal (security): Redaction checklist: remove IP addresses of customer infra, replace hostnames with HOST_REDACTED, redact IAM account IDs, and strip raw logs. Also remove plaintext encryption keys and AWS account numbers.
maya (legal): Also redact PII per our data handling policy. I'll attach the formal redaction checklist once jamal finishes the short list.
olivia (partnerships): Timeline: we want artifacts uploaded by Tue EOD to hit the marketplace review Wed morning; partner announcement Friday. Is that realistic?
rachel (si-partner): Yes for us, Tue EOD works. We'll need the presign path and an owner to validate redactions.
jamal (security): I'll do a quick validation pass Wed morning. If anything looks off, I'll ping legal.
sam (infra): Presign command (aws cli) for owners:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-catalog-evidence/cloudcatalog/si-acme/2026-03-22/report.pdf --expires-in 1209600
```
Change expires-in to 86400 for 1 day TTL.
olivia (partnerships): Who's the single point of contact for evidence ownership? Need a name for the marketplace intake form.
rachel (si-partner): Put "rachel (si-partner)" as partner owner and "jamal (security)" as redaction verifier. I'll copy our compliance ops.
maya (legal): I'll add the NDA note: full reports require signed NDA and audit scope. We'll route NDAs via docu-sign to rachel@si.com if needed.
jamal (security): Action items: 1) Rachel uploads redacted SOC2 summary + pentest to s3 path (by Tue EOD). 2) Sam presigns links (14d default). 3) Jamal verifies redaction Wed AM. 4) Maya final legal sign-off if any PII/PII risk.
olivia (partnerships): Perfect. I'll update the marketplace intake with owners and add the announcement checklist. Thanks team :tada:
security-bot: Reminder — attach ticket #MC-4789 to the evidence upload or the link will not be accepted by the marketplace intake system.
